1.text: Indirimbo ya Dawidi y'Amazamuka.Uwiteka, umutima wanjye ntiwibona,Kandi amaso yanjye ntagamika,Kandi siniha ibiruta urugero rwanjye,Cyangwa ibitangaza byananira.

2.text: Ni ukuri nturishije umutima wanjye ndawucecekesheje,Nk'uko umwana w'incuke yigwandika kuri nyina,Umutima wanjye wigwandika muri jye nk'umwana w'incuke.

3.text: Wa bwoko bw'Abisirayeli we,Ujye wiringira Uwiteka,Uhereye none ukageza iteka ryose.
